title: Prospective Selector Discrimination Failure-Mechanism Audit Protocol

audit_mode.purpose: Determine whether a prospectively defined structural, numerical, or objective-to-output coupling mechanism can explain the inherited selector-output compression.

admissible_source_scope.principle: Step3 may inspect only source/configuration objects necessary to trace the selector target, objective, optimization path, selector output transformation, utility/delta construction, and intervention mapping.
admissible_source_scope.discovery_rule: Because Step2 is frozen before implementation inspection, exact repository file paths are not asserted here unless already established by the frozen parent record. Step3 must first produce a deterministic source manifest using symbol/content discovery, and every inspected file must be included in that manifest with SHA256 before substantive audit findings are recorded.
permitted_source_categories: utility or selector output transformation functions
optimizer parameter-group configuration relevant to selector parameters
training-runner wiring that connects the above components
configuration values directly controlling the above components
existing tests directly exercising the above components
prohibited_source_categories: unrelated model components except where needed to establish an interface boundary
new external evidence introduced to select a correction

D1_selector_output_path_audit.name: SELECTOR_OUTPUT_PATH_AUDIT
D1_selector_output_path_audit.frozen_question: Does the implemented selector output path contain a structural or numerical mechanism capable of explaining the inherited low utility-probability variance?
required_trace: temperature, scale, clamp, normalization, detach, cast, or equivalent transformation if present
required_static_checks: tensor shapes and dimensions across the output path
activation semantics
softmax/sigmoid/logit use and dimensional axis
fixed scaling or temperature values
clamping, clipping, normalization, centering, averaging or reduction
detach/no_grad/stop-gradient operations on the output path
dtype conversions capable of reducing numerical resolution
constant/default/fallback paths capable of forcing near-neutral outputs
batch/sample reductions capable of collapsing per-sample discrimination
reuse or overwrite of selector outputs before intervention mapping
evidence_required: source manifest with repository-relative path and SHA256
symbol/function/class name for each relevant operation
line-local or AST-equivalent source excerpt identifier
explicit presence/absence table for each required static check
candidate explanatory mechanisms stated without modifying code

adjudication.EXPLANATORY_DEFECT_IDENTIFIED: At least one concrete source/configuration mechanism is present on the selector output path, is directionally capable of compressing or collapsing sample-level selector discrimination, and the causal link can be stated from code semantics without using post-correction results.
adjudication.NO_EXPLANATORY_DEFECT_IDENTIFIED: The complete admissible output path is traced and none of the prospectively enumerated structural/numerical mechanisms provides a concrete code-semantic explanation for the inherited compression.
adjudication.NOT_ADJUDICABLE: The complete output path cannot be established from admissible frozen source/configuration evidence, or required semantics depend on unavailable runtime evidence.
adjudication.anti_overclaim: D1 identifies a code-semantic explanatory mechanism, not sole causal proof. No code change or post-correction performance evidence is permitted in D1 adjudication.

D2_objective_to_output_coupling_audit.name: OBJECTIVE_TO_OUTPUT_COUPLING_AUDIT
D2_objective_to_output_coupling_audit.frozen_question: Given inherited nonzero selector optimization signal and parameter movement, does the implemented training objective provide a structurally adequate coupling from counterfactual target signal to the discriminative selector output used downstream?
required_trace: selector prediction used by the objective
relationship between optimized prediction and downstream utility_probability
relationship between optimized prediction and intervention input
required_static_checks: prediction-target tensor contract
target range versus output activation/range
loss function semantics
loss weight magnitude and configuration source
mean/sum/normalization reductions
detach/no_grad operations between objective and downstream selector output
whether the optimized tensor is the same semantic quantity consumed downstream
whether multiple heads/branches cause the optimized selector output to differ from the intervention selector output
whether selector parameters are actually included in the intended optimizer group
whether any frozen/default value bypasses learned selector output downstream
evidence_required: source manifest with repository-relative path and SHA256
candidate coupling defects stated without modifying code

adjudication.COUPLING_DEFECT_IDENTIFIED: At least one concrete source/configuration mechanism is present that structurally weakens, mismatches, bypasses, or semantically disconnects the counterfactual target/objective from the discriminative selector quantity consumed downstream.
adjudication.NO_COUPLING_DEFECT_IDENTIFIED: The complete admissible target-to-objective-to-downstream-output path is traced and no prospectively enumerated structural coupling defect is identified.
adjudication.NOT_ADJUDICABLE: The complete coupling path cannot be established from admissible frozen source/configuration evidence, or required semantics depend on unavailable runtime evidence.
adjudication.anti_overclaim: D2 is a structural coupling adjudication. It does not infer that a different loss, weight, architecture, or hyperparameter would improve results unless separately tested under a later prospective protocol.

ordering: Adjudicate D2 independently from D2 evidence.
Do not force D2 to agree with D1.
No correction is selected in Step3.
cross_audit_decision_logic.correction_gate: Any Step4/Step5 corrective disposition must be based only on remotely frozen Step3 audit evidence and must select the minimum correction justified by that evidence. Step2 and Step3 do not authorize modification.

step3_execution_contract.title: Read-Only Selector Discrimination Failure-Mechanism Audit Execution
results_must_include: exact parent Step2 commit and protocol hashes

frozen_prohibitions: no implementation modification during Step3 audit execution
no corrective patch selected before Step3 evidence is frozen
no lowering of the inherited discrimination threshold because v0.34 failed
no architecture or loss redesign during audit
no use of post-correction outcomes to reinterpret D1 or D2
no claim that absent intervention independently proves activation-mapping failure while selector discrimination remains unresolved
no rewriting of frozen v0.34 or v0.35 Step1 artifacts
